description: Search live LinkedIn job listings by keywords and location: 25 jobs with company, location, posted date, salary when listed, description and apply link. Use it when: A job-hunting or hiring-research task needs current openings. Not for: Candidate or recruiter profiles; people data is removed. Returns: 25 jobs: title, company, location, posted date, seniority, contract and work type, salary when listed, applicant count, description and apply link. Typical time: about 14 s. Price: $0.016 per search (up to 25 jobs), charged only on success. One call = up to 25 jobs.

keywords.description: Job title or skills, e.g. data analyst

location.description: City, region or country, e.g. Chicago
